answer: To thwart Sybil clusters, the network enforces quadratic stake burning for concurrent node registration: minting the nth identity burns stake proportional to n^2 tokens. An attacker attempting to cultivate an unearned grove of automated identities encounters superlinear cost scaling that freezes liquid capital like an advancing glacier. Carving persistent identity records into an immutable marble ledger binds cryptographic commitments to irreversible economic friction, rendering mass identity spoofing mathematically unprofitable.
